run_tf_batching_server: run the transformers classification batching server with a model on a specified host and port
create_classification_app: create a FastAPI app for sequence classification with configurable batch size and timeout
run_classification_inference: run classification inference on a batch of text inputs and return logits with input lengths
test_classification_warmup: test the classification model with a warm-up inference batch before serving requests
review_graceful_shutdown: review the graceful shutdown handler that cancels pending requests and cleanup resources
